question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a
stimulus: suitable word based on the information of the text.15 = 5 Lake Baikal is the deepest and one of the biggest and most ancient lakes of the world. It is situated almost in the centre of Asia. Lake Baikal is a gigantic bowl set 445 meter | 182 above sea level. This grand, enormous, unusual and charming miracle of nature is located in the south of eastern Siberia, in the Buryat Autonomous Republic and region of Irkutsk, Russia. The lake covers 31,500 sq.km. It is 636 km long and an average of 48 km wide. The widest point of the lake is 794 km. The water basin occupies 557,000 sq. km. and contains 23,000 cu.km. (cubic kilometer) of water, which is about one fifth of the worlds reserves fresh surface water. There are hot springs in the surrounding area of Lake Baikal. The quality of the water of these springs is excellent. Baikal is a stormy lake. The wind blows in various directions. The weather depends on the wide. If is blowing from the north, the weather is bright and sunny. The water of the lake looks green and dark blue. But if the winds get stronger, Baikkal turns black, waves rising high with white crest. The beauty of Lake Baikal is exceptional. [Unit-8; Lesson-4] The deepest and the most ancient lake of the world is the Lake Baikal. The (a) ⎯ position of this magnanimous lake is nearly in the heart of Asia. The area of this lake is 31,000 sq. km. The Lake Baikal is (b) ⎯ by many hot springs which are excellent (c) ⎯ of water. Due to the blowing of the wind in to several direction, the Lake Baikal always (d) ⎯ a stormy look. Green and dark blue aspects of the lake water are quite natural (e) ⎯ there are the fury of the wind. Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. India has many beautiful historical places of interest, but the beauty of the Taj Mahal surpasses the beauty of all other places. So the Taj is considered as a majestic Piece of art and architecture. It is in Agra in India. It stands on the bank of the river Jamuna. Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan of Delhi built this about hundred 50 years ago. This is the finest example of Mughal Emperor. Architecturally, it is still one of the most beautiful buildings in the world. It is the symbol of immortal love. It is made of five white marble with inlays of colored marble. It rests on a platform or terrace of red Sandstones. There is a large dom above the centre of the building. The Taj Mahal is surrounded by a beautiful garden. All these feature have made this really attractive, visitors come to see this building a different times of the day. The Taj seems most appealing on moonlit nights.
